# Worst Room

> > Worst Room is a comprehensive home and lifestyle guide covering interior design, gardening, cooking, and practical household solutions.

Founded by experts including Rick Worst, Jen Worst, and contributors Chris Miller, Omar Alonso, and Anne Cowart, Worst Room provides detailed guides on home improvement, plant varieties, culinary topics, and everyday household questions. The site combines practical DIY advice with educational content about design, gardening, and food.

## Key Topics

- Interior Design & Home Improvement
- Garden Plants & Flowering Plants
- Closet Design & Paint Selection
- Fountain Types & Water Features
- Outdoor Decor & Landscaping
- Cooking & Culinary Guides
- DIY & Household Solutions
- Plant Varieties (Lavender, Myrtle, Rhubarb)
- Kitchen & Food Safety
- Wall Treatments & Decoration
- Furniture & Home Furnishings
- Garden Fountains & Self-Contained Fountains
- Light vs Dark Colors
- Pet Hair Removal
- Thermal Shock & Glass Safety

## Home Improvement & Interior Design

- [The Best Colors for Closets: More Than Just Paint!](https://worstroom.com/colors-for-closets): Closet color selection guide covering paint & interior design aspects

- [Can You Paint Over Chrome? It's Not Easy, But Yes](https://worstroom.com/can-you-paint-over-chrome): Chrome painting guide: surface prep & techniques for metal finishing
- [Why is it Called a Loveseat? The Full Quick Answer](https://worstroom.com/why-is-it-called-a-loveseat): Loveseat etymology & history: furniture definition & sizing explained
